Format.description: The file's format name; first key of the file.

Version.description: The format version this build writes; older versions are migrated when read.

BaseColor.description: The linear base colour and alpha, multiplied with BaseColorMap.

BaseColorMap.description: The sRGB base colour texture; null for none (White is bound).

Metallic.description: How metallic the surface is: 0 dielectric, 1 metal; multiplied with the map's blue channel.

Roughness.description: The perceptual roughness: 0 mirror-like, 1 fully rough; multiplied with the map's green channel.

MetallicRoughnessMap.description: The linear texture holding roughness in green and metalness in blue (glTF); null for none.

NormalMap.description: The tangent-space normal map; null for none (FlatNormal is bound).

NormalScale.description: The strength of the normal map's X and Y deflection.

OcclusionMap.description: The linear ambient occlusion texture (red channel); null for none.

OcclusionStrength.description: How much the occlusion map darkens ambient light: 0 none, 1 fully.

Emissive.description: The linear emitted colour, multiplied with EmissiveMap and EmissiveStrength.

EmissiveStrength.description: The emission multiplier for HDR emission (KHR_materials_emissive_strength).

EmissiveMap.description: The sRGB emission texture; null for none (Black is bound).

AlphaMode.description: How the base colour alpha is used.

AlphaCutoff.description: The alpha below which Mask discards a pixel.

DoubleSided.description: Whether back faces are drawn (and lit with flipped normals).

UVScale.description: The scale applied to texture coordinates before UVOffset (KHR_texture_transform).

UVOffset.description: The offset added to scaled texture coordinates (KHR_texture_transform).
